three_points_only.name: IMPLEMENT_COMPATIBLE_SKELETON
requirements: Preserve existing bridge/reasoning and Qwen materialization byte-for-byte.
Do not delete, replace, rename or silently mutate existing infrastructure.
Add Knowledge Operator, KNOWLEDGE_INTERFACE/1.0 and provider-neutral cooperation contract with REASONING_INTERFACE/1.0.
Do not create duplicate engine identities for E05/E06/E07/E14; bind as backend/support relationships only.
Knowledge Operator and Shared Reasoner know each other's stable interfaces; MarkLogic and Qwen do not hard-code each other.

three_points_only.name: DOWNLOAD_MARKLOGIC12_THROUGH_MAIN
requirements: Use main as the read-only recovery/acquisition root.
Download the official Progress MarkLogic 12 Docker image exactly once when absent.
Pin the resulting repository digest and image identity as provenance evidence.
Do not activate, license-configure or promote MarkLogic during acquisition.

three_points_only.name: VALIDATE_AND_CERTIFY_EXACT_FROZEN_SCOPE
requirements: G23 independently verifies compatibility, no deletion, no Qwen mutation/redownload, no duplicate engine identity, no provider hard-binding, provenance and fail-closed boundaries.
G24 certifies only the same frozen digest after G23 PASS.
Certification propagation is forbidden and ACTIVE remains false unless separately authorized.
